name: banking77_routing
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. What is the customer's specific request or problem?

criteria.activate my card: wants to activate a card they received
criteria.age limit: asks about minimum age to open or use an account
criteria.apple pay or google pay: asks about using Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.atm support: asks which ATMs they can use or where to withdraw cash with the card
criteria.automatic top up: asks about setting up or how auto top-up works
criteria.balance not updated after bank transfer: made a bank transfer into their account but the balance hasn't updated
criteria.balance not updated after cheque or cash: deposited a cheque or cash but the balance hasn't updated
criteria.beneficiary not allowed: can't add a beneficiary / payee, or transfer to a beneficiary is not allowed
criteria.cancel transfer: wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they made
criteria.card about to expire: card is expiring soon; asks about renewal/replacement for expiry
criteria.card acceptance: asks where the card is accepted / whether merchants take it
criteria.card arrival: ordered card has not arrived yet; where is my card
criteria.card delivery estimate: asks how long card delivery takes or delivery options/countries
criteria.card linking: wants to link or add a card they have to the app/account
criteria.card not working: card is not working in general (not specifically contactless, ATM decline or virtual)
criteria.card payment fee charged: asks why there is a fee for paying by card / why card payments are charged (a question about the fee itself)
criteria.card payment not recognised: says they did not make or authorise a card payment, don't recognise a payment/merchant, or don't know where a charge came from (possible fraud)
criteria.card payment wrong exchange rate: the exchange rate on a specific purchase/payment/transaction was wrong or different than expected
criteria.cash withdrawal charge: was charged a fee for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.cash withdrawal not recognised: sees a cash withdrawal they didn't make
criteria.compromised card: thinks their card details were compromised or someone else used/has access to their card
criteria.country support: asks which countries the service is available in / supported
criteria.declined cash withdrawal: an ATM cash withdrawal was declined
criteria.direct debit payment not recognised: sees a direct debit they don't recognise
criteria.disposable card limits: asks about limits on disposable virtual cards (how many uses, etc.)
criteria.edit personal details: wants to change personal details like name or address
criteria.exchange charge: asks about fees/charges for exchanging currency
criteria.exchange rate: general question about what exchange rates are used or current rates, not about a specific past transaction
criteria.exchange via app: wants to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra charge on statement: asks about a small extra charge of a specific amount on the statement (e.g. an extra $1 or £1 charge), or says a transaction charged them extra when it shouldn't have
criteria.failed transfer: a transfer failed / did not go through
criteria.fiat currency support: asks which currencies can be held, exchanged or used to add money
criteria.get disposable virtual card: wants to get a disposable virtual card
criteria.get physical card: has a physical card and asks how to get/obtain it or its PIN
criteria.getting virtual card: wants to get a (non-disposable) virtual card
criteria.lost or stolen phone: lost their phone or it was stolen; worried about app access
criteria.order physical card: wants to order a physical card
criteria.passcode forgotten: forgot the app passcode or needs to reset it
criteria.pending card payment: a (card) payment or purchase is still pending, or asks what a pending payment means
criteria.pending cash withdrawal: a cash withdrawal is still pending
criteria.pending transfer: an outgoing transfer is still pending
criteria.pin blocked: their PIN is blocked after wrong attempts
criteria.receiving money: asks how to receive money / payments into the account
criteria.refund not showing up: a refund from a merchant has not shown up
criteria.request refund: wants a refund for a purchase, or wants to cancel/stop a card purchase they made
criteria.supported cards and currencies: asks which cards (e.g. from other banks/countries) and currencies are supported for top-up
criteria.top up by bank transfer charge: asks about a fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top up by card charge: asks about a fee for topping up with a card
criteria.top up by cash or cheque: wants to top up with cash or a cheque
criteria.topping up by card: asks how topping up by card works / card top-up issues
criteria.transaction charged twice: was charged twice for the same transaction
criteria.transfer fee charged: was charged a fee for a transfer
criteria.transfer into account: asks how to transfer money into their account
criteria.transfer not received by recipient: recipient hasn't received a transfer they sent
criteria.transfer timing: asks how long transfers take to arrive
criteria.verify my identity: asks how to verify their identity
criteria.verify source of funds: asks about verifying the source of their funds
criteria.verify top up: asks about verifying a top-up (e.g. verification code for card top-up)
criteria.visa or mastercard: asks whether cards are Visa or Mastercard / wants a specific one
criteria.why verify identity: asks why identity verification is needed
criteria.wrong amount of cash received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash
criteria.wrong exchange rate for cash withdrawal: the exchange rate on a cash/ATM withdrawal was wrong or different than expected
